outcome: distance from the anterior trophoblastic border to the uterine serosa
cohort: 56 patients with first-trimester sonographic diagnoses of cervicoisthmic implantations and previous cesarean deliveries
finding: The distance from the anterior trophoblastic border to the uterine serosa was significantly smaller in women with abnormally adherent trophoblastic implantations (cesarean scar pregnancies and placental invasion) compared to women with normally implanted pregnancies.
mod_finding: Women with previous cesarean deliveries and cervicoisthmic implantations were more likely to have abnormally adherent trophoblastic implantations.
